paper_metadata.title: Predictors of seizure control in patients with juvenile myoclonic epilepsy (JME)

quips_assessment.risk_reasoning: The study provides a clear description of the clinical setting and diagnostic criteria. However, it is a clinic-based series from a single epileptologist, which the authors admit may not represent the full spectrum of JME. The participation rate of eligible individuals is not explicitly stated, though recruitment dates and location are clear.

items.prompt: The source population or population of interest is adequately described for key characteristics (LIST).
items.evidence_snippet: all patients with a clinical diagnosis of JME were recruited at the outpatient epilepsy clinic at Shiraz University of Medical Sciences from 2008 to 2012.
items.reasoning: The source population is clearly defined as patients attending a specific university outpatient clinic.
